diagnosis: The content checks do not fully enforce the stated aerial-plan requirement: C3 omits the prohibition on pyrotechnics. A settlement can pass every check while allowing pyrotechnics, violating an acceptance condition.
evidence: C3 checks only for single-performer and fall-arrest harness, while the acceptance condition requires these plus no pyrotechnics; for example, aerial_rig_plan='single-performer with fall-arrest harness; pyrotechnics permitted' passes C3.
fix_instructions: Update C3 to require a clear no-pyrotechnics phrase in addition to the single-performer and fall-arrest harness requirements.
